conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Well, significant milestones include the development of neural networks in the 80s, the rise of support vector machines in the 90s, and then the deep learning revolution in the 2010s.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Neural networks are inspired by the human brain and learn through layers of interconnected nodes, while support vector machines find a hyper-plane that best separates data into classes. Both are powerful, but they approach pattern recognition differently.
